verdict.rationale: Parsec is a remote-desktop product, and a product of this kind could ship a natural-language or assistant control layer, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no natural-language command interface at all. The Teams API for deployment automation is a developer building block, not natural-language operation, and probes found no llms.txt or machine-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
